prompt: Photorealistic cinematic live action, exactly as in the image: her right thumb hovers over the wide amber button for a moment, then presses it once; the button darkens briefly under the press and the thumb lifts; her fingers hold the phone steady and the screen stays as it is. The camera holds still in macro, the thumb and the screen sharp, the office soft behind. Every face, hand and arm keeps its form; no extra limbs appear and none vanish; nobody's face changes. The printed Munchly product labels on the cartons (the maroon band, the batch and best-before boxes, the barcode and the QR code) and the Munchly packets stay exactly as they are, crisp and legible, and never change; the app screen on the phone stays exactly as it is, sharp and legible, and never changes to anything else. No other text, letters, logos or lettering appear anywhere. Natural light, 35 mm, shallow depth of field, no handheld shake.
negative_prompt: text, lettering, logo, brand name, label, watermark, subtitles, children
